installModal.title: Install plugin

sources.title: Plugin source
sources.optionalHint: Sources are optional. Plugins without one can still run, be configured, and be upgraded by uploading a package.
sources.adminOnly: An administrator can manage release sources and updates.
sources.runtimeUnaffected: This does not change the plugin runtime.
sources.downloadOriginsHint: Up to eight HTTP(S) origins, one per line. Leave blank to use the source origin only.
sources.allowInsecureHttp: Allow insecure HTTP for manual operations
sources.insecureHint: HTTP is not authenticated transport. Explicitly approved HTTP sources cannot enable automatic updates.
sources.localHint: Uses the version carried by this NarraFork program, not an arbitrary local folder.
sources.homepageHint: Only an explicit HTTP(S) homepage becomes a safe external link. Blank keeps plain text; no repository or publisher fallback is used.
sources.packageHint: The package supplies an optional source hint.
sources.conflict: The saved source changed while you were editing. Reload it or save against the original revision to receive a conflict.
sources.invalidSource: Enter a valid source configuration. URLs must be HTTP(S), without credentials; required source fields cannot be empty.
sources.invalidMetadata: The optional source metadata could not be used. The plugin can still run.

diagnostics.SOURCE_INVALID: The optional source metadata is invalid. Plugin operation is unchanged.
diagnostics.SOURCE_MISMATCH: The optional source metadata belongs to a different plugin. Plugin operation is unchanged.
diagnostics.SOURCE_UNREADABLE: The optional source metadata could not be read. Plugin operation is unchanged.

updates.title: Release updates
updates.runtimeSeparate: Checking a release is separate from retrying the existing runtime. Installed state is reported by the host, not inferred from download progress.
updates.noSource: No source is configured. Source checks, updates and automatic updates are unavailable; existing plugin operations still work.
updates.saveSourceFirst: Save or discard source edits before checking, updating, or changing automatic updates.
updates.automaticHint: Off by default. Only installed plugins with an approved source can update automatically; uninstalling does not trigger a reinstall.
updates.insecureManualOnly: This HTTP source is manual-only. Use HTTPS for automatic updates.
updates.allowTrustChange: Approve the trust change for this update
updates.allowTrustChangeHint: This is an explicit administrator decision for one update. The host still enforces any new capability grants; this does not automatically grant permissions.
updates.notCancellable: The host is committing this update. It can no longer be cancelled; the actual result will be reported.
updates.progressUnavailable: Could not load task progress. No successful update has been assumed.
updates.failed: The update task failed. Check the host-reported installed state.

errors.no_source: Configure a source before checking or updating.
errors.invalid_source: The configured release source is invalid.
errors.no_release: No release is available from this source.
errors.request_failed: The release request failed. The existing plugin is unchanged.
errors.rate_limited: The release source is rate-limiting requests. Try again later.
errors.invalid_release: The source returned invalid release metadata.
errors.unsafe_url: The host rejected an unsafe source or download URL.
errors.hash_mismatch: The archive digest did not match. The update was rejected.
errors.size_mismatch: The archive size did not match. The update was rejected.
errors.identity_mismatch: The archive belongs to a different plugin or version.
errors.incompatible: This release is not compatible with the current host or platform.
errors.manual_required: This update needs an explicit administrator decision; automatic updates keep the existing installation.
errors.source_changed: The source or its revision changed. Check again before updating.
errors.installation_changed: The installed package changed. Check again before updating.
errors.cancelled: The task was cancelled before commit.
errors.apply_failed: The host could not apply the update. Check the host-reported installed state.
errors.local_missing: The bundled archive is unavailable in this program.
errors.queue_full: The update queue is full. Try again later.

grants.title: Capability grants
grants.denyPermanentHint: Deny and never ask again; the plugin's calls to this capability will fail outright. You can lift it from the permanent denials list below.
grants.denyPermanentConfirmMessage: Permanently deny "{{capability}}"? The plugin's calls to this capability will fail outright and you will not be asked again. You can lift this decision later from grant management.
grants.denialsHint: These capabilities are permanently denied: calls fail outright and no permission request is raised. Lift a denial to let the plugin ask again.
grants.pendingHint: Plugins request capabilities here when they are not yet granted
grants.pendingUpgradeHint: An update declares capabilities this installation was never granted. They stay unavailable until you approve them; everything you approved before keeps working.

highRisk.highRiskNetworkEgressAllowlist: This capability lets the plugin make outbound network requests, including to LAN addresses, loopback, and link-local ranges. An allowlist that includes broad CIDR ranges (e.g. 0.0.0.0/0, 192.168.0.0/16) may enable access to internal services or cloud metadata endpoints (e.g. 169.254.169.254). Review the allowlist carefully before approving.
